Overview

Los Ángeles is a city in BI with a population of 200,000. An agricultural and forestry hub in southern Chile, surrounded by rivers and national parks. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables.
